charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1101_100:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] ran into Ghetsis
and Chien-Pao on a glacier.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_100:
Well, if it isn’t [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
What a coincidence running into you here.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_0401_100:
*chuckle* Curious, are you? I’m honored
you’d take such interest in me.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_0402_100:
Such an abrupt greeting. Children these days
have no manners.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_200:
Since we’ve been brought together for a
fateful encounter, I’ll make an exception and
spare you a few moments to chat.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_300:
Let me tell you the legends surrounding
Chien-Pao.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_400:
They say it was born of the snow-clad
hatred of those who perished by the sword
long ago.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_500: When someone wins, someone else loses.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_600:
Strong resentment must lie within those
swordlike fangs, as the legends say.
Wouldn’t you agree?
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_700:
The reason I came to this glacier is to let
past hatred and resentment fester and grow!
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_800:
I don’t mean only Chien-Pao’s. I have quite
a bit in my heart too.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_900:
Even if I wanted to forget how my plans to
freeze and rule Unova were foiled, it is
forever etched into my memories!
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_100:
In Unova and on Pasio, I’ve tasted bitter
defeat.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_110: Chien-Pao is the best tool for my revenge.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_0401_200:
Being used this way is but a joy for a
Pokémon with hate in its heart.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_0402_200:
Have you considered this is not only my wish
but also Chien-Pao’s?
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_120:
The hatred Chien-Pao and I feel is one and
the same. It resonates.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_140:
I am sure Chien-Pao wants vengeance
as much as I do.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_150:
I suppose you could try to stop us. If you do,
I wish you luck.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_160:
All you would achieve is new hatred in
us both.
charaepi_ch0195_10_ghetsis/2301_1201_170:
Myah-ha-ha-ha! I always have such
pleasant conversations with you!
